definitions.gloss: independent study project; free research assignment
definitions.explanation: A school assignment, classically over summer vacation, in which a student chooses a topic and investigates it freely — through experiments, observation, crafts, or fieldwork.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{自由研究|じゆうけんきゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{困|こま}っている→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: I'm stuck on my summer independent study project.

examples.english: For my independent study project, I kept an observation journal of morning glories.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧ (free) + ⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧ (research). A long-standing summer-vacation tradition in Japanese elementary and junior-high schools; choosing the topic is famously a source of headaches for students and parents.
